hub_identity.reservation_rule: Create the ticket under registry lock before writing runners, artifacts, data, or logs. Existing IDs are rejected across registry, JSONL, tickets, logs, artifacts, data, and runners.

hypothesis: PIT SEC Companyfacts diluted-share-count contraction paired with liquid SPY-relative confirmation may identify capital-return and anti-dilution leadership candidates without adding noisy tickers.

prediction.confidence_reason: Companyfacts exposes filed-date shares_diluted across all fixed windows and this field is distinct from rejected buyback text and cash-flow accruals; the risk is that share-count contraction is stale or just reselects existing mega-cap momentum.

execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $10 and ADV20 >= $50M from PIT OHLCV
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; no production adapter changes
execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing annual shares_diluted current/prior facts, missing OHLCV, missing next open, or missing 10d exit rejects the paper candidate

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same PIT annual diluted-share-count contraction gate, liquid SPY-relative confirmation, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.

post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The diluted-share-count contraction source did not clear Gate 4 (failed: window_ev_regression, window_pnl_regression, fewer_than_two_ev_improved_windows, drawdown_drift_too_high, accepted_distribution_ev_not_beaten, accepted_distribution_pnl_not_beaten). Do not promote or tune this fixed share-count contraction bundle on the same frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.outcome_summary: Aggregate EV delta +0.2890; aggregate PnL delta $+3,908.60; max drawdown drift +0.0124; 206 paper trades.
post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping diluted-share-count contraction threshold, max contraction cap, annual fact freshness, RS/close/volume/vol guards, top-N, hold days, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A retry needs materially different PIT shareholder-yield evidence such as explicit completion/progress fields, free cash flow coverage of buybacks, or closed forward replacement-value rows. Do not sweep share-count contraction thresholds, fact age, price guards, top-N, hold, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.
